messages.subject: For Pieter van Oord | Airport infrastructure, sustainability and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Royal Schiphol Group Press Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Pieter van Oord, Chief Executive Officer.

Schiphol's role as a major international airport requires disciplined alignment across government, aviation authorities, communities, sustainability priorities and complex operations. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and aviation stakeholder strategy might support Royal Schiphol Group's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Royal Schiphol Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
